BUG FOUND: Workspace ws-analyse-btn navigates to Research page but the Closed sub-tab is NOT activated — Research remains on VALIDATE. ui_bugs.issue: Clicking ws-analyse-btn navigates to Research tab correctly (ananta:navigate is caught by AppShell) but the Closed Trades sub-tab is NOT selected — it stays on VALIDATE. The 'ananta:research-closed' event is dispatched synchronously before Research.jsx mounts and registers its listener (race condition in Workspace.jsx:97-100). action_items: Fix ws-analyse-btn race condition — dispatch the 'ananta:research-closed' event AFTER Research mounts. Options: (1) wrap the second dispatch in setTimeout(..., 50) so it fires next tick; (2) persist target sub-tab in localStorage ('ananta_research_sub') and have Research.jsx read it on mount; (3) use a shared Zustand/context store instead of window events. Recommend option 2 (deterministic, no timing dependency).

Optional UX: the AI review takes ~25s in the modal (vs. spec's 10-15s hint). Consider a progress hint like 'This usually takes 10-25 seconds — thinking about your 44 trades…' inside the report-ai-review skeleton.
critical_code_review_comments: Workspace.jsx goAnalyse dispatches two window events back-to-back — 'ananta:navigate' and 'ananta:research-closed'. The first triggers tab switch (Research mounts on next React commit), the second fires immediately before the listener is attached in Research.jsx useEffect. Classic missed-event race. This will fail intermittently and does fail deterministically in the current build.

coach.py:trades_review is well-structured — pulls up to 300 recent closed sells, builds a deterministic snapshot (per-strategy pnl + exit reason histogram), and sends to Claude with a strict 'no preamble, no disclaimers' prompt. The 'no closed trades' short-circuit avoids burning credits on empty books. Nice.

server.py:report_trades_pdf mode filter maps 'paper' → {$in:['PAPER','DRY_RUN']} and 'live' → 'LIVE' — matches the same mapping in coach.trades_review, which is good consistency. The inline=true → Content-Disposition:'inline' switch is a clean one-liner.

ClosedTradesAnalysis.jsx re-fetches api.coachTradesReview on every modal open (no cache/memo). If a user rapid-clicks ANALYSE, credits will be spent multiple times. Consider a per-mode idempotency-ish cache within the component (or a spinner-disabled state during in-flight).

StrategyCenter.jsx edit-strategy-fab correctly gates on `isOwner && tab !== 'Parameters'` and does setTab('Parameters') + smooth scroll — verified both branches (owner shows/hides, non-owner never sees it).
ResearchWizard.jsx defaults changed to BTC + 1m via `avail.find((a) => a.startsWith('BTC'))` and useState('1m') — verified both defaults active on wizard-asset-BTC and wizard-period-1m.

The ws-analyse-btn race-condition bug is deterministic and reproducible — fix and retest by running the ws-analyse-btn flow and asserting research-subtab-closed data-state='active' after click.
rca of the issue: Workspace.jsx:97-100 dispatches window CustomEvent('ananta:navigate', {tabId:'research'}) followed immediately by window Event('ananta:research-closed'). AppShell.jsx:87 catches 'ananta:navigate' and updates its `active` state to 'research', causing Workspace to unmount and Research to mount. However, Research.jsx:30 attaches its 'ananta:research-closed' listener inside a useEffect that runs AFTER the first commit — which happens AFTER the second window.dispatchEvent has already fired synchronously. Result: the event has no listener and is dropped, so setSub('closed') is never called. Fix: either queue the second dispatch (setTimeout 0/50) or drive sub-tab selection through a persistent store (localStorage / context) that Research reads on mount.
